messages.author: Rudy Richardson
messages.body:
When installing AMBERTools23/AMBER22 on Linux Mint 21.1 Xfce (based on
Ubuntu 22.04 LTS), if I attempt to install the ReaxFF during compilation
(using cmake) by including -DBUILD_REAXFF_PUREMD=TRUE, I get an error
saying there is no such command. How can this be remedied? Thank you.
Rudy Richardson
University of Michigan
